    The crown case: reduction to P/μ #

    Let μ be a long morphism (maximal and not irreducible) of a finite ray category P with cancellation which occurs in no contour. If P/μ is chain-bounded, the fundamental group of P is free and every contour function on P is exact (BO13a, proof of Theorem 2, with the lemma of §3.1: RayCategories/Quotients/ResidueQuiver.lean, Fischbacher for Π and Roiter for H²).
